_comment: DORA client tools. Shared contract between the ElevenLabs agent config (Claude) and the browser implementation in agent/web/ (Codex). Tools run in the browser via @elevenlabs/client clientTools and call the local FastAPI (contracts/api-contract.md). Every tool returns a JSON string with ok=true|false. Do not rename tools or fields without updating both sides.

tools.name: get_tenant_context
tools.description: Load the caller's tenant, unit, building (address, heating type), the contracted SHK heating partner and the partner's offered appointment windows from Centrix. Call this once at the start of the conversation before asking anything the record already contains.

tools.name: create_maintenance_case
tools.description: Create a heating maintenance case in Centrix for the caller's unit. Call only after you understand the symptom (which rooms/radiators, since when). The created case becomes the current case for all later tools.

description.description: Short factual summary in the tenant's words: affected rooms or radiators, since when, hot water yes/no. No diagnosis.

priority.description: urgent only if the whole flat is cold or vulnerable people are affected; otherwise routine.

tools.name: save_availability_and_consent
tools.description: Store which partner windows the tenant is available in, plus the tenant's explicit booking authorization and consent to share address and issue with the SHK partner. Only window_ids returned by get_tenant_context are valid. Both booleans must reflect what the tenant actually said.

window_ids.description: One or more window_id values from get_tenant_context, e.g. ["W1"].

booking_authorized.description: true only if the tenant said yes to booking within these windows.

data_sharing_consent.description: true only if the tenant agreed to share address and issue details with the heating company.

tools.name: dispatch_to_partner
tools.description: Send the current case to the contracted SHK partner. This is a REQUEST, not a booking: the result status is awaiting_partner until the partner accepts a slot.

tools.name: get_case_status
tools.description: Read the current case status from Centrix. Only claim an appointment is booked when status is scheduled and appointment is present.

error_return.error: Short machine-readable code, e.g. backend_unreachable, not_found, invalid_state, consent_missing, unknown_window, no_current_case
error_return.message: One sentence the agent can relay to the tenant. Never implies success.

browser_state.note: Same key the tenant page (frontend/static/js/tenant.js) already uses, so voice and page show the same case.
